title: Income tax 'refund' needs your OTP, then penalty threat

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, I am calling from the Income Tax Department. You are eligible for a refund of 46,200 rupees.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To credit it to your account we have sent a verification code to your phone. Please read out the six digit OTP.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Why do you need my OTP?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Without it the refund is cancelled and a penalty for non-compliance is added. Officers may visit your house for recovery today.
